run_install_app: run install_app to register a WASM module with a given app name and .wasm file path
run_query_app: run query_app to list all installed WASM apps and verify they are registered
run_check_query_apps: run check_query_apps to validate that the queried app list matches expected app names
run_send_request: run send_request to send an HTTP GET request to a specific app resource endpoint
run_check_response_payload: run check_response_payload to verify the response JSON payload matches the expected key-value pairs
